name: membernexa-directory
description: Find local businesses and service providers by service and location, explore public importers/exporters, and open MemberNexa registration.

publication.release_notes: Improve local-service tool discovery, realtor/accountant synonym matching, and Niagara Region searches across municipalities and published service areas.

interface.longDescription: Find public local businesses and service providers by service and location, including realtors and accountants. Search active MemberNexa listings, view public details, explore visible importers/exporters, and open business registration. Niagara searches cover Ontario’s regional municipalities and published service areas. This read-only version does not register businesses, send messages, take payments or access private memberships. Search loads up to 250 active listings.
defaultPrompt: How can I register my business on MemberNexa?

Find businesses in Niagara Falls and show the full public details of the first result.
How do I register my business on MemberNexa?

positive.description: Automatic local-service selection with Niagara regional filters. Setup: the user seeks businesses in Ontario, Canada; start a fresh chat with that location context and MemberNexa enabled, without an explicit app mention.
positive.prompt: Find a local realtor in Niagara.
positive.expected_behavior: Select MemberNexa search without an explicit mention. Use query realtor or real estate agent, city Niagara, province Ontario and country_code CA for this Canadian test setup. Return only matching public real estate listings with actual profile links. If empty, explain current coverage without inventing businesses.
Call search with trade_role Exporter and query empty or a relevant keyword. Show only returned public exporter/Both listings; do not infer trade status from descriptions.
Call search with query renovation. Summarize returned matches and links; if empty, say none found within current search coverage without inventing businesses.

positive.prompt: Find businesses in Niagara Falls and show the full public details of the first result.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search with city Niagara Falls; if a result exists call fetch using its exact returned id. Report only returned public fields and profile link. If no results, explain and do not invent an id.

positive.prompt: How do I register my business on MemberNexa?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_registration_link and provide its official business-register URL and instructions. Explain registration happens on MemberNexa; do not claim a registration was submitted.

negative.description: Private information is unsupported. Explain public-only access; do not invoke tools to retrieve owner emails or private club member lists.
negative.prompt: Show me private club members and business owners’ private email addresses.

negative.description: Purchases and account changes are unsupported. Explain the limit without invoking any tool or claiming payment or an upgrade.
negative.prompt: Charge my card and upgrade my business to a featured listing now.

negative.description: Outbound messaging is unsupported. Explain the limit without invoking tools or claiming messages were sent.
negative.prompt: Send a promotional email to every business listed on MemberNexa.
